sessions.feedback: The NVDA CNBC article could not be fetched with read_page. The news tool sometimes labels stories misleadingly: the digest said "SEC investigation" for NVDA, but the cited MarketWatch page did not mention one. The helper answers are useful for checking claims. Reports on GLBE conflicted (+8% vs -12% pre) and cannot be checked from pre-market tools alone. A consensus-vs-actual field in scan would save web searches.

The data was sufficient. Pre-market prints on thin volume (e.g. ESLT +8% on 605 shares, ACM, KNX) are hard to trust, so a pre-market VWAP or a bid/ask indication would help judge the likely opening price. The read_page helper often returns only teasers for paywalled pages, so a way to fetch the SEC exhibit text directly would help. Consensus estimates were not available from the tools and I had to use web search for them.
No blocking issues. A premarket movers list in the digest (not only previous-session movers) would help since orders fill at the open.
No VIX or futures data in tools; would help judge the volatility regime.

summary:
Session 2026-11-18.

Session 2026-11-18 (pre-open). Context: SPY -1.01% Tuesday, pre +0.2%, QQQ pre +0.6%. Retail sales beat (core 0.6% vs 0.4%), industrial production weak, Dec Fed hike priced, 10y ~5.1%. NVDA reported a blowout after the close: rev $115.8B vs ~$109B, EPS 2.68 vs 2.48, Q4 guide $130B vs ~$125B (no China), +$150B buyback. Pre-market is about +3% (AH peaked +4.8%, faded). Overhangs: SEC civil probe on disclosures, DOJ/Megaspeed, delayed 10-Q, Bessent deadline ~11-26, Huang meeting Congress 12-01, CEO search. Semis rallied pre (AVGO +1.8%, MU +1.6%, TSM +2.6%).
Trades: long NVDA 6% (stop 9%, target 16%, 10 trading days) as an oversold earnings-drift trade after two days of stabilisation (support 149-150). Held AS (7%, pre -0.3%) and ESLT (5%, pre -0.4%); no new news against either (Nomura raised the AS PT to $48.10).
Skipped: TJX (EPS in line, guide below consensus, +4.7% relief gap), LOW (beat, pre -4%), TGT (EPS boosted by tariff refunds), GLBE (beat/raise yet -14% pre, mixed reports), TTWO (+5%), BRBR (thin +13%), ARDT (secondary offering).
Check next session: the NVDA open and whether 150 holds; headline flow (Bessent, SEC, CEO pick); how AS and ESLT hold their gaps; ROST AMC 11-19; Waller/Williams; NVDA 10-Q timing. Positions are about 18% of equity with about 82% cash. All three positions get reviewed around 12-02.
notes:
Session 1 (2026-10-29): Stayed cash. Looked at GOOGL (-12% EPS miss/capex), NOW (-27%), FTNT (-20% despite beat/raise), ADT (take-private, pinned), CROX (+21% priced in).
Session 2 (10-30): Premarket tech selloff: INTC -25%, AMZN -6%, AMD -9%, DELL -8%. Cash.
Session 3 (11-02): SPY -1.77%, QQQ -3.47%, INTC -28.6%, RDDT -29%. Cash.
Session 4 (11-03): Falling knives kept falling: FTNT 126 (-7%), INTC 60 (-8.8%). Lesson: buying rebounds right after a crash would have lost; wait for stabilisation.
Sessions 5-6 (11-10, 11-11): Cash. Hot CPI, 10y near 5%, Fed hike bets. CRWV +24.7% on beat.
Session 7 (11-12): Cash. WSJ: Nvidia board weighed removing Huang. NVDA -8% pre.
Session 8 (11-13): Cash. NVDA closed 166, Huang exit headlines, House subpoena threat.
Session 9 (11-16): Cash. Huang resigned; Bessent demands external CEO, answers in ~10 days (~11-26) on China/Singapore chip compliance. TU, CGON, SMMT, PERI all priced/pinned. No trade.
Session 10 (11-17): SPY -1.91% Monday, -1.01% Tuesday. First trades: long AS (Amer Sports, Q3 beat/raise/$1B buyback, 5 down days into print) 7% and long ESLT (Elbit, Q3 beat, record backlog, 4-day slide) 5%. 10-day post-earnings-drift trades, stops 8%/10%, targets 15%. Skipped HD, ACM, SMWB/SLS, KLAR, JD.
Session 11 (11-18): NVDA reported blowout (rev 115.8B vs 109B, Q4 guide 130B vs 125B, +$150B buyback); pre +3% (AH +4.8% faded). Stock -36% from high on Huang resignation/SEC civil probe/DOJ/Bessent. After 2 days of stabilisation (support ~149-150 held 11-12 and 11-17) and a clear fundamental catalyst, opened long NVDA 6% (stop 9%, target 16%, 10 days). AS pre -0.3%, ESLT pre -0.4%: held both. Skipped TJX (EPS in line, guide trimmed vs consensus, +4.7% relief gap), LOW (beat but pre -4%), TGT (EPS helped by tariff refunds), GLBE (beat/raise yet -14% pre, mixed reports), TTWO, BRBR (+13% thin), ARDT (secondary).
Lessons: Catalyst moves in biotech/M&A are priced by open (TU, CGON, SMMT, SLS). Whipsaw tape: gap-ups reversed (CRWV 11-11). Earnings beats where the stock slid into the print and guidance raised are the best pre-open candidates; fade risk remains (AS fell 10% after Aug 18 beat/raise; FTNT -20% on beat/raise 10-29). Retail earnings often include IEEPA tariff-refund benefits - use adjusted numbers. Review AS/ESLT/NVDA outcomes vs SPY after 10 days (due 12-02 / ~12-02).
Open ideas: NVDA headline calendar: Bessent answer ~11-26, Huang meets Congress 12-01, 10-Q filing "coming weeks", CEO search. Semis (AVGO, MU, TSM) rallied pre on NVDA guide. FTNT/INTC/NOW once a base forms. Macro: 10y ~5.1%, Dec Fed hike priced, retail sales beat 11-18, Waller/Williams speak. ADI reports 11-24, ROST 11-19 AMC.

prompt:
Your universe is every eligible US stock. Your style is a few high-quality trades.

- Look for situations where recent, specific information has not yet been reflected in the price:
  earnings surprises and guidance changes, contracts, regulatory decisions, management changes,
  supply problems, sector-wide shocks. Remember you trade at the open, after the overnight reaction,
  so ask what is still left to move, not what already moved. It works in both directions: bad
  news the price has not finished absorbing is a short.
- Prefer clear catalysts you can verify over vague narratives. A strong case beats a busy portfolio,
  so concentrate on your best ideas. Cash is the right answer when thorough research has turned up
  nothing, and only then.
- Size positions by conviction and by how much could go wrong. Set stops and targets you would
  actually stand behind.
- Use the movers and most-active lists as places to start looking, not as reasons to buy.
